section_title: Scope. Mechanical appliances, equipment and systems shall be constructed, install
text:
2801.1 Scope. Mechanical appliances, equipment and systems shall be constructed, installed and maintained in ac-
cordance with the New York City Mechanical Code and the New York City Fuel Gas Code. Masonry chimneys,
fireplaces and barbecues shall comply with the New York City Mechanical Code and Chapter 21 of this code.
